summary.overview: During the M&A catch-up meeting, significant progress on the TSG deal was highlighted, with a shifted focus from EBITDA to revenue growth, resulting in a more reasonable financial forecast that will be communicated to Caci and Ziff Davis. The momentum call was positively received, particularly regarding concerns over integration, with Momentum expressing interest in expanding into the UK market. While potential buyers like Strata Cash and Outbrain showed initial interest, they have since paused due to various factors, leaving Momentum, Caci, and Ziff Davis as strong contenders. The financial model saw adjustments, with projected revenue for 2024 increased and EBITDA margins adjusted to 30-33%. The meeting also delved into content and media deals, where customer concentration issues were noted, and Zen Media appears poised for sale with multiple NDAs signed. As the year wraps up, there are indications of five more interested parties for TSG, but no major deal movements are expected until the new year. Action items were established for follow-up communications and outreach to interested parties.
summary.short_summary: Significant progress on the TSG deal was discussed, notably the shift from EBITDA to revenue growth, leading to a more realistic financial forecast for Caci and Ziff Davis. Momentum expressed a desire to expand into the UK market, while initial interest from buyers like Strata Cash and Outbrain has waned, leaving Momentum, Caci, and Ziff Davis as key players. Adjustments to the financial model increased projected revenue for 2024, with EBITDA margins revised to 30-33%. The meeting also highlighted concerns around customer concentration in content and media deals, and Zen Media is positioned for sale with several NDAs signed. As the year ends, five additional interested parties for TSG have emerged, but major deal movements are anticipated only in the new year, with action items for follow-up communications established.
